perfect.title: Perfect
perfect.summary: The exact best option at every decision. It gives the lowest house edge, and nothing does better.
rules: **Preflop:** 4x with the hands on the chart (pairs 33 and up, any ace, any suited king, K5o+, Q6s+, Q8o+, J8s+, JTo), otherwise check. 3x is never best.
**Flop:** the exact best of 2x or check, found by looking at every possible turn, river and dealer hand. The basic flop rule matches it almost always.
**River:** the exact best of 1x or fold, found by looking at every dealer hand. The basic river rule matches it almost always.
Perfect play differs from the basic rules only in rare spots; the EV sheet always shows the exact answer.

expert.title: Expert
expert.summary: The chart preflop, the basic flop rule and the exact river decision. Used as a fast stand-in for perfect play in long simulations.
rules: **Preflop:** the chart (the same as perfect).
**Flop:** the basic flop rule.
**River:** the exact best of 1x or fold.

basic.title: Basic
basic.summary: The practical strategy: a chart you can learn, two flop rules and one river rule.
rules: **Preflop:** 4x with pairs 33 and up, any ace, any suited king, K5o+, Q6s+, Q8o+, J8s+ and JTo. Otherwise check.

**Flop:** bet 2x with two pair or better that uses your cards, or a hidden pair (a pocket pair other than 22, or a hole card matching a flop rank), or four to a flush with a ten or higher of that suit in your hand. Otherwise check.
**River:** bet 1x if you have a hidden pair or better, or if fewer than 21 unseen cards would beat you. Otherwise fold.

simple.title: Simple
simple.summary: The lightest practical strategy, with short preflop and flop rules.
rules: **Preflop:** 4x with pairs 33 and up, any ace, any king, Q8 or better, and JT. Otherwise check.
**Flop:** bet 2x with two pair or better that uses your cards, or a hidden pair. Otherwise check. There is no flush rule.
**River:** the same as basic.

check-to-river.title: Check to the river
check-to-river.summary: The cautious player: never bets early, then decides exactly at the river. A common habit that is costly.
rules: **Preflop:** always check.
**Flop:** always check.
**River:** the exact best of 1x or fold.

never-fold.title: Never fold
never-fold.summary: Checks every street and always bets 1x at the river. Shows what the "never fold" myth costs.
rules: **Preflop and flop:** always check.
**River:** always bet 1x.

always-max.title: Always bet the maximum
always-max.summary: Bets 4x every hand before the flop. The fun and maniac strategy.
rules: **Preflop:** always bet 4x, whatever the cards.
There are no more decisions after that.

river-leak.title: River leak
river-leak.summary: A lesson-only strategy that gets the river wrong. It is not a practical preset.
rules: **Preflop:** 4x with any pair or any ace. Otherwise check.
**Flop:** bet 2x with a hidden pair or two pair or better. Otherwise check.
**River:** bet 1x only with a hidden pair; fold everything else.
